sentences.en: For all his genius, he is as unknown as ever.
sentences.zh: 尽管他才华横溢，却依然默默无闻。

sentences.en: It was all like a single equation with two unknowns.
sentences.zh: 这就像一个有两个未知数的一元方程。

sentences.en: The enemy cavalry crossed the river by an unknown ford.
sentences.zh: 敌军骑兵通过一处不为人知的浅滩渡过了河。

phrases.zh: 通过一处不为人知的地方

senses.zh: 未知的；陌生的，默默无闻的
未知的事物，默默无闻的人；[数]未知数
